notes: BP5 is a directory. These cases name the metadata index. They are not a byte-level BP5 file and not an ORNL conformance suite.

cases.title: BP5 metadata index name
cases.paragraph: A BP5 dataset is a directory. The metadata index file is named md.idx.

cases.title: BP5 metadata file name
cases.paragraph: BP5 writes md.0 next to md.idx. The name is part of the directory marker.

cases.title: Missing md.idx
cases.paragraph: A directory with no md.idx is not a BP5 dataset. An empty marker is rejected.
